column1: # AI CLI provisioning manifest (SR-076, LLR-1104, IF-038). Tab-separated, one row per artifact; '-' means none.
# Columns (read by provision-ai-clis.sh and tests/test_provision_ai_clis.py): key version needed_by url sha256 size_bytes kind tree inventory entry version_cmd version_regex target requires
# needed_by: source:<AI_USAGE_SOURCES name>, service:ai-cli, service:ai-cli:openai (only when an enabled ai-cli route is an OPENAI-family row),
#   or required-by:<key> (a dependency row, installed only for the row that requires it).
# kind: file (single binary) | tar | zip | nodetar (tar.xz with one leading directory stripped). tree: whole (extract all, assert inventory) | member (extract the entry only).
# inventory: space-separated relative paths that must exist after extraction. version must equal the version token in url and match version_regex.
# Hashes are trust-on-first-pin (vendor signatures are not verified). Changing any row changes the install identity and so triggers a fresh install.
